subject.title: Image tool fails to resolve media:// protocol paths for inbound Discord media

question: Should maintainers prioritize a live Discord DM attachment repro now, or wait for reporter logs before allowing a code repair?
rationale: Source inspection shows the resolver failure path but not which Discord-specific state, root, or retention path loses the file, so an automated repair would be guessing at the boundary.

options.title: Run live Discord repro
options.body: Capture the saved path, emitted `media://inbound` ID, active state dir, and image-tool failure on current main before implementing a fix.

options.title: Wait for reporter logs
options.body: Keep the issue open but require gateway logs, `media.ttlHours`, and the emitted media ID/path pair before triaging a repair.

options.title: Defer as stale later
options.body: If no live proof or logs arrive after the stale window, close as insufficient information rather than merging a speculative media fallback.

recommendation.title: Run live Discord repro
recommendation.body: Capture the saved path, emitted `media://inbound` ID, active state dir, and image-tool failure on current main before implementing a fix.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the recent media-reference implementation history and is the strongest routing candidate for deciding the proof bar before repair.
